doc: The bundle reading of the body the job reading renamed a task in (databricks.fbl#configuration; FBL 0.10, section 9.1; spec 066, User Story 2, scenario 2). ../renamed.yml is byte for byte the body after the last step of job/ beside this folder: the bundle reading reads it without a reload, as the same open body, and since its metamodel draws resources and not tasks, the rename leaves every element it reads as it was; it edits that body in turn, an edit that one history holds with the rename.

steps.doc: The bundle reading edits the renamed body: dev is no longer the default target, a replace-value of its default.

expectFiles.../renamed.yml:
# The lakehouse bundle: one nightly ingest job (declared in resources/), one declarative
# pipeline refining bronze into gold, deployed to a development and a production target.
bundle:
  name: lakehouse

include:
  - resources/*.yml

variables:
  catalog:
    description: The Unity Catalog everything below writes into.
    default: lakehouse_dev
  warehouse_id:
    description: The SQL warehouse the dashboard refresh runs on.
    default: "4b9b953939869799"

resources:
  jobs:
    nightly_ingest:
      name: Nightly ingest
      job_clusters:
        - job_cluster_key: ingest_cluster
          new_cluster:
            spark_version: 15.4.x-scala2.12
            node_type_id: Standard_DS3_v2
            num_workers: 2
      schedule:
        quartz_cron_expression: "0 0 1 * * ?"
        timezone_id: UTC
      tasks:
        - task_key: land_raw
          job_cluster_key: ingest_cluster
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/land_raw
            base_parameters:
              catalog: ${var.catalog}
        - task_key: gate
          depends_on:
            - task_key: land_raw
          condition_task:
            op: GREATER_THAN
            left: "{{tasks.land_raw.values.rows_landed}}"
            right: "0"
        - task_key: publish
          depends_on:
            - task_key: gate
              outcome: "true"
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/publish
        - task_key: alert_on_empty
          run_if: AT_LEAST_ONE_FAILED
          depends_on:
            - task_key: gate
              outcome: "false"
          spark_python_task:
            python_file: scripts/alert_on_empty.py
        - task_key: refresh_dashboard
          depends_on:
            - task_key: publish
          sql_task:
            warehouse_id: ${var.warehouse_id}
            query:
              query_id: 9d3f2b1a
  pipelines:
    bronze_to_gold:
      name: Bronze to gold
      catalog: ${var.catalog}
      schema: gold
      serverless: true
      channel: CURRENT
      libraries:
        - notebook:
            path: transformations/bronze
        - notebook:
            path: transformations/silver
        - glob:
            include: transformations/gold/**
      notifications:
        - email_recipients:
            - data-eng@vrenken.eu
          alerts:
            - on-update-failure
            - on-update-fatal-failure

targets:
  dev:
    mode: development
    default: false
  prod:
    mode: production
    resources:
      pipelines:
        bronze_to_gold:
          catalog: lakehouse_prod
          serverless: false
      jobs:
        nightly_ingest:
          schedule:
            quartz_cron_expression: "0 0 2 * * ?"

steps.doc: Undo makes dev the default again.
